definitions.explanation: A partnership where a couple lives together as if married but has not submitted a marriage registration ({婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}). In Japan, this means the couple functions as spouses in daily life but is not legally recognized as married under the family register system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{事実婚|じじつこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The two are in a common-law marriage.

examples.japanese: {事実婚|じじつこん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{扶養手当|ふようてあて}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are cases where dependent allowances are recognized even in common-law marriages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えたくない→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{事実婚|じじつこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of couples choosing common-law marriage because they don't want to change their surnames is increasing.

notes:
USAGE:
{事実婚|じじつこん} is a topic of growing relevance in Japan, where married couples are legally required to share the same surname ({夫婦同姓|ふうふどうせい}). Some couples choose {事実婚|じじつこん} to avoid this requirement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事実婚|じじつこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パートナー→パートナー：11287_paatonaa⟧ (common-law partner)
- {事実婚|じじつこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (to choose common-law marriage)
- {事実婚|じじつこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧ (rights of common-law spouses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{内縁|ないえん}→内縁：25710_naien⟧ is a legal term for de facto marriage, often used in legal and administrative contexts. {事実婚|じじつこん} is more commonly used in general discussion.
